boards.title: Your First Weekend at California Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative first-weekend sequence for getting oriented, meeting people, finding student resources, and sampling Caltech’s campus life without relying on one-time events.

cards.title: Start at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Find the campus hub
cards.notes: Walk through the public lounge, locate the meeting rooms, and note where the store and Red Door Marketplace sit before weekend plans begin.
cards.short_summary: Use Caltech’s central student gathering place as the starting point for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech identifies the Hameetman Center as a gathering space for student programs and activities that houses Red Door Marketplace, the Caltech Store, performance space, and meeting rooms.
cards.access_notes: Student-center rooms may be reserved or in use; follow posted access notices and event signage.

cards.title: Check the Campus Store
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Handle practical supplies
cards.notes: Browse school supplies and Caltech-authored books, then note the store’s location for anything forgotten during move-in or orientation.
cards.short_summary: A practical early stop for supplies, technology accessories, books, and Caltech merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current catalog says the Institute-operated Caltech Store is on the Hameetman Center’s first floor and stocks Caltech authors’ books, school supplies, hardware, accessories, gifts, and insignia merchandise.
cards.access_notes: Check the store’s posted operating hours before visiting; browsing and purchasing availability may differ.

cards.title: Plan a Red Door Meal Stop
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Learn the weekend dining rhythm
cards.notes: Check the posted menu and weekend schedule before ordering, and use the stop to identify an easy campus meeting point for classmates.
cards.short_summary: Red Door provides a named dining landmark inside the student center and operates on a different weekend meal pattern.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s dining overview lists Red Door Marketplace among campus dining locations and states that it serves dinner on weekends.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists weekend dinner service but not precise hours; confirm the current schedule and menu before going.

cards.title: Follow the Olive Walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Build a mental campus map
cards.notes: Walk the main pedestrian route in daylight and connect the residential side of campus with landmarks you identified on Friday.
cards.short_summary: A simple orientation walk along one of Caltech’s principal pedestrian routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech describes the Olive Walk as one of the main pedestrian thoroughfares on campus.
cards.access_notes: Use established walkways, respect residential privacy, and follow any temporary construction or access signs.

cards.title: Pause at the Turtle Pond
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Take a quiet outdoor break
cards.notes: Bring a notebook or sit for a short reset beside the pond, keeping paths clear and observing the turtles without feeding or handling them.
cards.short_summary: Throop Memorial Garden offers a recognizable outdoor pause during a first campus circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech identifies Throop Memorial Garden as the campus location affectionately called the turtle pond because of its reptilian residents.
cards.access_notes: Remain on public paths and lawns, avoid disturbing wildlife, and observe any temporary grounds restrictions.

cards.title: Test Your Library Access
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Find a future work base
cards.notes: Bring your Caltech ID, locate the circulation area, and identify a suitable work zone so the building is familiar before coursework accelerates.
cards.short_summary: Use the first weekend to learn how entry and study access work at Caltech’s Sherman Fairchild Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech Library states that its facilities and resources are open to the campus community and marks library access as requiring a Caltech ID.
cards.source_title: Can ArtCenter College of Design students and faculty use the Library? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: A Caltech ID is required. Verify the current weekend building hours through the library’s hours link before departing.

cards.title: Survey Recreation Options
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Add movement to the weekend
cards.notes: Check the weekly facility schedule, tour only areas covered by your access, and choose a low-key activity suited to your experience level.
cards.short_summary: An orientation stop for understanding Caltech’s gyms, courts, fields, pools, and changing weekly schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech Athletics lists Braun Athletic Center among its recreational facilities and publishes weekend building and facility hours while directing users to weekly schedules for current details.
cards.source_title: Recreational Facilities - California Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Weekend facility hours vary by area, and pool hours can change. Check the weekly schedule and confirm your access eligibility.

cards.title: Explore the Activities Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Locate student-run spaces
cards.notes: Find the center beneath the south undergraduate housing complex and look for club, publication, music, gaming, or screening resources of interest.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused stop for discovering spaces tied to organizations, creative work, publications, and group activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current catalog says the Student Activities Center is open for student use 24 hours a day and contains club rooms, rehearsal and publication spaces, a shop, a small library, and a movie screening room.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for student use according to the current catalog; individual rooms may have separate controls or reservations.

cards.title: Learn the Public-Events Landmark
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · Bookmark future programs
cards.notes: Walk by the auditorium, recognize its exterior, and bookmark the public-events calendar rather than assuming a performance is scheduled this weekend.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the campus venue used for public science talks and performing-arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech states that Beckman Auditorium hosts music, theater, and dance performances and identifies it as the home of the free, public Earnest C. Watson Lecture Series.
cards.access_notes: Auditorium entry depends on a scheduled event and its admission rules; consult the current event listing before entering.

cards.title: Finish by Finding the Caltech Y
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Identify ways to join in
cards.notes: Locate the Wilson Avenue office, review current student opportunities, and subscribe to announcements before committing to a program or trip.
cards.short_summary: End the weekend with a concrete path toward service, outdoor, cultural, educational, and social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Caltech Y says its programs span educational activities, outdoor adventures, community service, social activities, and cultural events, with student leadership at their center.
cards.access_notes: The office lists weekday hours, so use Sunday to locate it and review online programs; registrations and costs vary by activity.
